# Tests that fail under DEFRA_CLIENT=go-http because defradb.rs deliberately behaves differently from Go.
# Enforced by .github/scripts/testo-report.ts on the go-http job only:
# - each line is `<binary> <test>`, optionally followed by why it diverges; no issue is needed;
# - a listed test that passes fails the job ("converged: remove from the list"), so the list only shrinks;
# - a listed test that no go-http shard selects fails the summary ("missing");
# - an entry a pull request adds is printed as a warning naming that pull request.
# A test belongs here or in known-failures/go-http.txt, never both.
testo collection_version::updates::add::simple::collection_version_updates_add_simple_errors_adding_unsupported_collection_prop Rust names the missing path ("path /Foo/Fields does not exist"); Go reports "add operation does not apply: doc is missing path"
testo collection_version::updates::add::simple::collection_version_updates_add_simple_errors_adding_unsupported_collection_prop_at_root Rust names the missing path ("path /Foo does not exist"); Go reports "add operation does not apply: doc is missing path"
